hero.title: Vocation - Job Search Chrome Extension
hero.tagline: Streamline your job search with intelligent templates, tracking, and automation

sections.title: The Challenge
sections.content: Job seekers spend countless hours copying information between job boards, rewriting cover letters, and tracking applications in spreadsheets. The process is fragmented, repetitive, and prone to errors. The goal was to create a unified tool that works across all job platforms to automate these workflows.

sections.title: Technical Approach
sections.content: Built a Chrome extension using Vue.js that injects an overlay interface into job board websites. The extension uses content scripts to extract job information, provides smart templates for communication, and stores application data locally with Chrome's storage API.

subsections.title: Cross-Site Integration
subsections.content: Developed intelligent selectors that work across 20+ job boards including LinkedIn, Indeed, and Glassdoor, automatically extracting job details regardless of site structure.

subsections.title: Template Engine
subsections.content: Created a dynamic template system with variable substitution, allowing users to generate personalized cover letters and messages in seconds.

sections.title: Implementation Details
sections.content: The extension features a non-intrusive overlay that appears when browsing job listings. Users can save jobs with one click, access templates from a slide-out panel, and view application metrics in a dedicated dashboard. All data is stored locally for privacy.

sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.content: Vocation transformed the job search experience for thousands of users, reducing application time by 60% and increasing response rates through better-targeted communications. The extension maintains a 4.8-star rating on the Chrome Web Store.
metrics: 60% reduction in time per job application

backend: Chrome Storage API for data persistence
